cumulative_round_snapshot.recipe: Not regenerated: the load-bearing records (oracle/query_*/result.json receipts, manifests, progress reports) are committed beside it.
cumulative_round_snapshot.why: Each round's snapshot CONTAINS every earlier round, so a K-round campaign stores itself K times.

run_log.recipe: Not regenerated; the run's own artifacts carry its results.
run_log.why: Worker stdout/stderr from a completed run.

source_capsule.why: Verbatim copy of every file a run read, 12-17 MB per attempt.

upstream_oracle_asset.recipe: PyTDC downloads these on first use into the directory AssetPinnedOracle pins around every call.

zero_oracle_gate_workspace.recipe: Re-run the gate. NOTE its ledger is shaped like a scored run but its scores are NOT production scores -- tools/reproduce_pmo_tables.py excludes it on that evidence.
zero_oracle_gate_workspace.why: Campaign state from a gate that charged no oracle calls. Its own committed report is the artifact worth keeping; the workspace is rebuilt from scratch on every run.
